proj1_body: Chatbot that writes and optimizes Python code with OpenAI GPT models. Uses RAG to pull the right specifications from a knowledge base and draws control-flow and data-flow graphs of the generated code.

proj6_title: Distributed Data Processing with Apache Spark

proj5_body: Automated trading systems that extend my MSc thesis: a market-making bot that traded live on Revolut X with real capital (risk limits, kill-switch, alerts, live dashboard) and a Bybit platform that streams real order-book data and backtests strategies.
res6_body: Studies where the safety of an LLM trading system comes from: five CrewAI agents with local 3–8B models (Ollama) quote BTCUSDT on real Bybit data, while code computes and validates every price. Ablations measure the role of each guardrail.
